related.title: FORMOSAT-7/COSMIC-2 福衛七號
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若教學可用容量 700 MB，原始量化估算通過但 16 bit 容器超限，須修改儲存或取像計畫。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: At 700 MB teaching capacity, quantization-only estimate passes but a 16-bit container fails, requiring storage or acquisition changes. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 把觀測、候傳與處理拆成延遲預算，檢查平均值是否掩蓋逾時。
related.differenceEn: Separate observation, waiting and processing latency and test whether averages hide late data.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學影像 10000×10000 pixel、4 波段、每像元每波段 12 bit，以十進 MB 計。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：V=10000²×4×12/8/10⁶。 結果約 600 MB。未壓縮資料量=NxNy×波段數×每像元位元/8；未含封包、標頭與校驗。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學接收間隔 90 min、處理及傳送固定 15 min，忽略失敗重送。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：平均延遲=90/2+15。 結果約 60 min。規律間隔 T 的下一站等待在均勻相位假設下平均 T/2；最壞近 T，與處理延遲相加。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching image is 10000×10000 pixels, four bands and 12 bits per pixel per band, in decimal MB. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: V=10000²×4×12/8/10⁶. Result ≈ 600 MB. Uncompressed bytes=NxNy×bands×bits/8, excluding packets, headers and checksums.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching contact interval is 90 min plus 15 min fixed processing/transmission, ignoring retries. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Mean latency=90/2+15. Result ≈ 60 min. With regular contact interval T and uniform phase, mean waiting is T/2 and worst case approaches T; add processing latency.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 太空碎片減緩與退役
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若教學可用容量 700 MB，原始量化估算通過但 16 bit 容器超限，須修改儲存或取像計畫。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: At 700 MB teaching capacity, quantization-only estimate passes but a 16-bit container fails, requiring storage or acquisition changes. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 建立退役功能成功鏈，辨認壽命末期電源、導航和致動可靠度的共同限制。
related.differenceEn: Build a disposal-function success chain and identify end-of-life power, navigation and actuation constraints.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學影像 10000×10000 pixel、4 波段、每像元每波段 12 bit，以十進 MB 計。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：V=10000²×4×12/8/10⁶。 結果約 600 MB。未壓縮資料量=NxNy×波段數×每像元位元/8；未含封包、標頭與校驗。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學末期電源成功率 0.99、導航 0.98、單一致動功能 0.95，暫假設獨立。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：P成功=0.99×0.98×0.95。 結果約 0.92169 fraction。獨立串聯功能成功率相乘；平行備援只改善該功能，不能消除上游失效。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching image is 10000×10000 pixels, four bands and 12 bits per pixel per band, in decimal MB. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: V=10000²×4×12/8/10⁶. Result ≈ 600 MB. Uncompressed bytes=NxNy×bands×bits/8, excluding packets, headers and checksums.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching end-of-life success rates are power 0.99, navigation 0.98 and one actuator function 0.95, initially independent. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Psuccess=0.99×0.98×0.95. Result ≈ 0.92169 fraction. Independent series-function success probabilities multiply; parallel redundancy improves only that function, not upstream failures.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
